title: Listing add-ons
description: Manage optional add-ons that providers attach to their listings.

help.title: About listing add-ons
help.overview: An add-on is an extra a client can choose when ordering a listing, such as express delivery or an extra revision. It adds its price and, if set, extra days.

sections.title: Each add-on
items: It belongs to one listing; only that listing's provider can add or remove its add-ons.
Its currency must match the order's (the package's, or the listing's); otherwise the order is blocked.
A client can choose each add-on once.
